messages:
Alex P.: Customer ask: single /advisor endpoint that returns batching, caching, quantization recs + estimated cost delta and confidence score. Wants per-route breakouts.
Priya K.: Product likes it. Need firm MVP boundaries: advisory vs automated changes.
Mike L.: Eng reality: we can emit actions like enable_prefix_cache=true, target_batch_size=24, quant_profile=q8_0 and an estimate of tokens saved and p50 change. Cost delta calc = tokens_saved * account_price_per_token (has noise).
Jess R.: Ops: for Dedicated, recs must flag whether infra changes are required (autoscale, pool resize) vs runtime switches. Different rollout playbooks.
Sam T.: sales-bot: "Customer A says they'd pilot if we show >=20% token savings with <=10% p50 regression."
Alex P.: Draft launch gates: (1) Advisor API (read-only) that returns recs+confidence+plain-language rationale (2) Console view with per-route econ impact and accept-preview buttons (3) Eval safety checks for any quant recs.
Priya K.: MVP = read-only suggestions (no auto-apply). Agree?
Mike L.: Agree. Implementation plan: heuristic rules + lightweight model using seq-len distribution + model variant profile. Limit quant recs to vetted profiles per model family at launch.
Maria S.: Eng-ML: tie to evals: block quant rec if eval suite shows quality regressions beyond threshold. Also emit eval-triggered alerts when a recommended quant reduces score.
Jess R.: Edge cases to call out: streaming responses (can't coalesce batches across streams), tool-calling chat flows (KV semantics), and re-ranking pipelines. Mark as scoped-out for initial auto-apply.
Sam T.: Customers want an "estimated monthly $ impact" in Console. We should show a clear assumptions disclaimer.
Mike L.: For preview/dry-run: full trace replay is expensive. Initial preview will be a simulation using recent seq-len histogram + kernel perf table. Later add trace replay for higher fidelity.
Priya K.: UX: per-route accept + dry-run before apply seems safest. We should also add audit logs and a canary rollout (5%).
Alex P.: Acceptance criteria bullet list: 1) recommendations validated on 3 internal workloads -> median token reduction >=15% 2) UI shows confidence + rationale 3) eval-safety blocking for quant 4) retention of only aggregated econ data unless customer opts-in.
Jess R.: Rollout playbook tasks: audit events, rollback button, canary policy, rate-limited apply jobs, and an ops runbook for incidents.
Maria S.: Metrics returned by Advisor: predicted_token_savings, predicted_cost_delta, expected_p50_change, confidence_score, short_rationale.
Sam T.: Sales follow-up: include API POST /advisor/preview for programmatic dry-runs.
Mike L.: Note: preview returns simulated numbers; label clearly. We'll need a job to compute account price_per_token for cost math.
Priya K.: Prioritization for Q2 MVP: 1) Read-only Advisor API + Console UI 2) Eval safety checks for quant 3) Preview API (sim) 4) Audit + accept flows 5) Auto-apply is backlog.
Alex P.: Action items: Mike -> API schema + sim math by Tue, Priya -> acceptance criteria doc, Jess -> rollout & compliance notes, Sam -> collect pilot customers. Sync Thu 10am to finalize scope. :thumbsup:
sales-bot: Pilot candidates posted: Customer A, Customer B, Customer C. :robot_face:
